kashika: अन्तश्शब्दादुत्तरं वनमन्तोदात्तं भवति। अ॒न्त॒र्व॒णो देशः। अनुपसर्गार्थ आरम्भः॥
kashikaEnglish: Samāsa with upamāna: end-acute on second in certain cases.
englishFull:
उपमानात्सामान्यवचनं च — After comparison, a general term is end-acute.

General descriptive terms following a comparison take end-accent, distinguishing them from specific body-part comparisons.
